summary: @servicetitan/hammer-token@3.1.1 downloads Bun runtime at install to execute a 727KB obfuscated bundle
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`setup.mjs`, itself named with obfuscator.io-style identifiers) downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases and uses `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'],...)` to execute the sibling file `math_init.js` during `npm install`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a rotating string-array (`WV8StW`), a scrambled base64-style alphabet, and a dispatcher (`hc1jfK9`) that resolves opaque values at runtime; no plaintext strings tie it to design-tokens/Style-Dictionary functionality. The bundle also imports `child_process`, `fs`, and `http`, reads `process.env`, and issues outbound `POST`/`fetch` traffic to hosts reconstructed at runtime. The delivery shape (alternate-runtime dropper compiled only for Bun so Node-based scanners cannot introspect it), the purpose mismatch (a design-tokens library has no reason to ship a Bun-compiled binary bundle and pull a fresh runtime to execute it), and the obfuscator.io-style renaming of the loader together establish an install-time arbitrary code execution surface against every consumer of this version. Installing this version resolves to attacker-controlled code being executed on the installer's machine before any application code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
